rationale: The opening bounce on this -16% gap failed below session VWAP at $19.77 and price is fading with descending closes, which leans bearish — but at $19.45 a short entry sits only 0.46% above the day's low, so the stop above the bounce high is roughly four times the distance to first support, a poor-risk location.
